writeup: Krowne's 21-132L is the commercial-grade, low-lead spray valve assembly for its Royal Series pot fillers, the kind of replacement part restaurant kitchens buy. Woot has it for $54.99, versus $97.35 at Web Kitchen Depot and $98 at eTundra.
